title: Netanyahu Calls UK 'First Islamic Republic to Get a Nuclear Weapon' in Major Diplomatic Provocation
detail: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu publicly called the United Kingdom 'the first Islamic republic to get a nuclear weapon,' a sharp diplomatic provocation targeting British foreign policy amid tensions over the Iran conflict. The remark reflects Israeli frustration with UK positions on Iran and signals deepening friction between Jerusalem and London over how to handle Tehran's nuclear programme and the broader regional conflict.

media.caption: Netanyahu's remarks provoke major diplomatic row with the UK over Iran nuclear stance
